Container.Name: band3-rooms
Container.Overview: A Liveless Rooms server for band3 (the PC recompilation of Rock Band 3) and RB3Enhanced. Each game logs in and gets a short room code; a player who enters someone's code is told where that game is, and the games then connect to each other directly. The server only introduces games: it never carries game traffic, so whoever hosts still needs UDP 9103 forwarded to their own PC or console.[br][br]Forward TCP 19532 from your router to this server. Set Address to the host name players will enter as their Rooms server, exactly as they'll type it.[br][br]If some players are on the same network as this server, set LAN public IP to your public address so players from outside are sent somewhere they can reach.

Config.Name: Rooms port
Config.Description: Where games log in. RB3Enhanced always uses 19532; band3 can use another with :port in its Rooms server setting.

Config.Name: Address
Config.Description: The server's host name exactly as players enter it (band3's liveless_rooms_server without :port, RB3Enhanced's LivelessAddress); login proofs are signed with it. Comma-separated for more than one.

Config.Name: LAN public IP
Config.Description: Your public IPv4, given to games that connect from your own network; blank = their LAN address

Config.Name: Allow versions
Config.Description: Optional: only clients whose version starts with one of these (comma-separated), e.g. idio-sync/band3 for band3 only

Config.Name: Deny versions
Config.Description: Optional: turn away clients whose version starts with one of these (comma-separated); wins over Allow versions

Config.Name: Require proof
Config.Description: Ask games to sign their login with Address, and check emulators' signatures

Config.Name: Allow consoles
Config.Description: Take logins from real Xbox 360s running RB3Enhanced, whose signatures can't be checked

Config.Name: Ping
Config.Description: How often each game is pinged; games hang up after 30 s of silence, so keep it well under

Config.Name: Timeout
Config.Description: Drop a game that has sent nothing for this long; 0 = never

Config.Name: Login timeout
Config.Description: Drop a connection that hasn't logged in after this long; 0 = never

Config.Name: Max connections per IP
Config.Description: Connections at once from one address; 0 = no limit

Config.Name: Failed joins per connection
Config.Description: Joins to a code that doesn't exist, per minute, per connection; 0 = no limit

Config.Name: Failed joins per IP
Config.Description: Joins to a code that doesn't exist, per minute, from one address; 0 = no limit

Config.Name: Stats endpoint
Config.Description: Optional: host:port for GET /stats (version, players online, open rooms), for a status page; e.g. 0.0.0.0:19533 with that port mapped, ideally only to a web server in front of it. Blank = off

Config.Name: Hex log
Config.Description: Log every packet in hex, for debugging
